scope: Instances of the Becoming core's laws in constructed peripheral machines. Reading acquired words: for every lexicon whose transition record groups the two-word encoding, every encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms exactly when each word form resolves to its atom (from Segmentation.reads_every_iff); the histories learned 32, coordinated 37, acquired 51, retrospective 36 and the fixed decoder of experienced 28 are instances, and the peripheral bond is the core's majority bond. Readout: the four-integer summary of the two-qubit fragment carries a law and is exact after every course of moves. Formed goal revision: a practice runs n cycles from an account exactly as the work covers the cycles the reserve does not support; every operation of the learning goal keeps the goal and selector and adds the transition loss if any; revision completes exactly under access loss with kept maintenance, after which n operations run exactly when n <= 5 (n <= 2 without reform) and the earlier loss is retained; the harmful headline is an instance. Gated change: the practice machine's traces are its completed runs, only revision changes the recorded methods and only an organizational adoption changes the rule. Cross-situational binding: for every lexicon whose repertoire has no repeats, a word resolves to its atom exactly when its admitted records separate the atom (CrossSituational.resolves_iff); after every history of an enacted scene every sequence is read exactly when the earlier records and those heard, each offering what was accessible where the learner stood, separate every atom (coordinated 37 is an instance; stationary 37 fails separation, mistimed 37 coverage); cooperative naming narrows exactly the words whose atoms are accessible; for every memory whose packets of a form are produced by learned worlds with the target, the binding view resolves the form to the target exactly when every other meaning is ruled out by a packet no learned world with it produces (retrospective 36 is an instance, and after a real route change the target is not produced). Learning is better than attendance exactly under access loss with kept maintenance, and revision completes exactly there. A practice round completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose method answers as the context does, and then only records the review, trains the worker and completes the trial; the three rounds of the complete history are instances. Correspondence of these machines to actual learners, quantum systems, people or organizations is not checked.
